scripts.version:sync: node -e "const v=process.argv[1]; if(!v) process.exit(1); const fs=require('fs'); ['package.json','src-tauri/tauri.conf.json'].forEach(f=>{const d=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(f));d.version=v;fs.writeFileSync(f,JSON.stringify(d,null,2));}); const c=fs.readFileSync('src-tauri/Cargo.toml','utf8').replace(/^version = \".*\"/m, 'version = \"'+v+'\"'); fs.writeFileSync('src-tauri/Cargo.toml',c); const g=fs.readFileSync('android/app/build.gradle','utf8').replace(/versionName \".*\"/, 'versionName \"'+v+'\"'); fs.writeFileSync('android/app/build.gradle',g); const p=fs.readFileSync('PKGBUILD','utf8').replace(/^pkgver=.*/m, 'pkgver='+v); fs.writeFileSync('PKGBUILD',p); console.log('Successfully updated version to ' + v);"
scripts.release: node -e "const v=process.argv[1]; if(!v){console.error('Harap masukkan versi, contoh: npm run release 0.1.3'); process.exit(1);} const execSync = require('child_process').execSync; const run = (cmd) => console.log(execSync(cmd, {encoding: 'utf8'})); run('npm run version:sync -- ' + v); run('git commit -am \"bump version to v' + v + '\" || true'); run('git checkout main'); run('git pull origin main || true'); run('git merge dev -X theirs -m \"Release v' + v + '\"'); run('git push origin main'); run('git tag v' + v + ' || true'); run('git push origin v' + v); run('git checkout dev'); run('git merge main -X theirs'); run('git push origin dev'); console.log('🎉 Sukses merilis versi v' + v + ' dan kembali ke branch dev!');"
